name: Secrets Exchanged
desc: Nefer's specialty. "How about this in exchange for a story?" No sooner are the words out of her mouth than a plate of fragrant, crispy spheres appears in front of you. Before you have time to agree, she gently catches your hand. "Oh, and by the way," she adds, "each mouthful buys at least one sentence." ...Sure enough, one has to pay the right price for a taste of Nefer's cooking...

customize.name: Recipe: Panipuri
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Panipuri.

customize.name: Panipuri
customize.desc: An appetizer served with a green dipping sauce. The crispy balls are first deep-fried, then stuffed with a delicious filling through a hole on the top. The bite-sized snack is a common street food in Sumeru.

customize.name: Nefer
customize.desc: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

customize.name: Potato
customize.desc: A chunky vegetable. A gift from the earth that you never tire of with its multitude of cooking methods.

customize.name: Glabrous Beans
customize.desc: A common legume in Teyvat with a light aroma. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, and is thus widely accepted by people all over the world.

customize.name: Spice
customize.desc: A seasoning with varied flavors. It is made from dried Harra Fruits and can enrich the taste of a dish. Therefore, Sumeru locals say, "Spice goes well with anything."
